Railway police at a major railway terminal intercept an 8-year-old unaccompanied boy, Rahul, wandering on the platform in a distressed state. Statement I: Hospital laundry management strictly prioritizes microbiological disinfection, sterile handling, and total eradication of pathogenic contaminants.
